summary: Tested Master Admin org tier upgrade/downgrade and user edit features for iteration 115. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Tier dropdown shows free/pro/premium/enterprise options, role dropdown shows Owner/Manager/Staff options, Edit User dialog has all required fields (Full Name, Email, Job Title, Phone, Role, Save button).

backend_01_update_org_tier_to_free.details: PUT /api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/subscription with tier=free returns success=true, tier=free

backend_02_update_org_tier_to_pro.details: PUT /api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/subscription with tier=pro returns success=true, tier=pro

backend_03_update_org_tier_to_premium.details: PUT /api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/subscription with tier=premium returns success=true, tier=premium

backend_04_update_org_tier_to_enterprise.details: PUT /api/master-admin/organizations/{org_id}/subscription with tier=enterprise returns success=true, tier=enterprise

backend_05_verify_tier_persists.details: Tier change persists when fetching org list again

backend_06_invalid_tier_rejected.details: Invalid tier values return 400 Bad Request

backend_10_edit_user_full_name.details: PUT /api/master-admin/users/{user_id}/edit with full_name updates and persists

backend_14_edit_user_multiple_fields.details: PUT /api/master-admin/users/{user_id}/edit with multiple fields updates all at once

backend_15_edit_nonexistent_user_404.details: Editing non-existent user returns 404 Not Found

backend_16_edit_user_empty_body_rejected.details: Empty update body returns 400 Bad Request

frontend_01_tier_dropdown.details: Tier dropdown shows Free, Pro, Premium, Enterprise options

frontend_02_tier_dropdown_selection.details: Selecting tier from dropdown triggers API call and updates UI

frontend_03_user_role_dropdown.details: Role dropdown on each user row shows Owner, Manager, Staff options

frontend_04_edit_user_button.details: Edit pencil icon button on each user row opens Edit User dialog

frontend_05_edit_user_dialog_fields.details: Edit User dialog has Full Name, Email, Job Title, Phone, Role dropdown, Save button

critical_code_review_comments: Code review passed - Org tier upgrade/downgrade and user edit features are fully functional
Backend API correctly validates tier values (free/pro/premium/enterprise) and rejects invalid values
User edit endpoint correctly updates role, full_name, email, job_title, phone fields
Frontend tier dropdown normalizes legacy tier values (professional, starter) to 'free' in the Select value prop
Frontend Edit User dialog has all required fields with proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing organizations and users
